ns2:section.sectionText: Title: Diversity, Equity, & Inclusion in STEM: The Science Behind Bias seminar. - Discuss the historical context of racism, exclusion, and bias in science. - Read from and discuss the primary literature to understand the science of bias why it is present, and how it has continued to persist across the Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) fields - Identify actions we can each implement as individuals, as well as steps institutions can take, to decrease bias and promote equity and inclusion.
